FFmpeg SDK license evidence status
==================================

RELEASE BLOCKED

This file is an evidence record, not a replacement for the license text and
not a grant of rights.

The local `ffmpeg.exe -L` output identifies GNU GPL version 3 or later. The
local executables also consistently report both `--enable-gpl` and
`--enable-version3` in their embedded configure line. The manifest therefore
uses the locally evidenced classification `gpl-3.0-or-later`.

The SDK directory supplied to this repository did not contain a distributor
license bundle or the corresponding third-party license notices. Those
materials have not been reconstructed or guessed. `license.evidence_complete`
and `redistributable` remain false until authoritative license materials for
this exact build are supplied and reviewed.
